verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents the scriptable gcloud CLI, REST APIs and client libraries for automating workflows, Terraform-based declarative infrastructure, and Workload Identity Federation for keyless non-human workload authentication. Together these make headless automation a documented capability, but nothing explicitly documents CI-pipeline usage or non-interactive operation, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit docs for CI/CD pipeline integration and non-interactive or headless CLI flags, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
Google Cloud APIs allow you to automate your workflows by using your favorite language.
you can provide on-premises or multicloud workloads with access to Google Cloud resources by using federated identities instead of a service account key
Define your infrastructure declaratively using Terraform.
